Problem Statement:
You are given a number of books and are asked to distribute them among students. Every book has distinct number of total pages.The distribution of books can be done in many ways. In each way, one of the students will be allocated books such that the he/she has the maximum number of total pages. Your task is to find the minimuma among all the maximuma, i.e. in all the possible number of ways in which the maximum number of pages can be allocated to a student. Each book will be allocated to exactly one student and each student has to be allocated at least one book. Confusing? Check out the explanation!
input_spec:
The first line contains a single positive integer denoting the number of books.
The second line contains space separated positive integers denoting the pages of each book.
And the third line contains the number of students.
output_spec: Output a single line containing maximum pages that can be allotted to a student.
